name: Black Hole
description: Physically grounded black and white holes, as many as you like: real-time ray-marched gravitational lensing through Kerr spacetime (and its negative-mass mirror for white holes, with a blinding core and blue-white ejection disk), relativistic accretion disks with Doppler beaming, polar jets, Hawking radiation and a radiation zone, gravity with frame dragging, spaghettification, time dilation and its white-hole mirror, holes that grow, evaporate and merge, wormholes and the Singularity Dimension, spacetime corruption of the ground, Gravity Stabilizers, Event Horizon Goggles, a three-mode Mini Singularity Injector, an in-game control panel (B) and the /blackhole and /whitehole commands.
